messages:
Maria: Observed intermittent packet loss in Geneve overlay between GPU node pools in az-east-2, affecting training jobs (retries/backoffs). Spike started ~0400 UTC.
Devon: Observed ~0.5-2% loss in telemetry, concentrated east-west across racks. No NIC link flaps in cloud provider console.
Joel: Started tcpdump on gpu-node-3 and gpu-node-11. Lots of retransmits and some invalid encapsulation checksums.
Joel: tcpdump excerpt:
```
17:03:12.987654 IP 10.10.3.21 > 10.10.11.7: UDP, length 1450
17:03:12.987660 IP 10.10.11.7 > 10.10.3.21: UDP, length 60
```
Joel: many packets at ~1450 bytes near MTU boundary (Geneve + VLAN). Suspect GSO/GRO interaction with encap.
Maria: What are host MTUs and overlay MTU? Any recent kernel/driver changes?
Ashley: Physical NICs are MTU 9000. CNI overlay interfaces set to 1450. We rolled kernel 6.1.12 and mlx5 5.0.2 to a subset of GPU fleet yesterday.
Devon: `ethtool -k` shows gso/gro/tso enabled and geneve checksum offload on affected nodes.
Joel: When I disabled GRO on geneve interface on one node (`ethtool -K geneve0 gro off`), iperf tests between pods dropped loss to ~0% for the short run.
Maria: That implicates offload bug. Which nodes correlate with kernel roll?
Ashley: Affected nodes mapped to the new batch with 6.1.12 + mlx5 v5.0.2. Older nodes (6.1.5 + mlx5 v4.x) are stable.
Devon: Spinning up a repro: continuous 100 MB/s pod-to-pod streams across 50 pairs to validate.
Joel: Capture `ethtool -S` and `dmesg` as well; looking for mlx5 warnings and soft errors.
sre-bot: Incident created: SRE-2026-0318-encap-loss assigned to Maria and Devon. Oncall: Joel.
Maria: Short-term mitigation: DaemonSet to disable GRO/GSO/TSO on geneve interfaces on affected nodes (`ethtool -K geneve0 gso off gro off tso off`).
Ashley: Rolling canary 10% of GPU pool. If stable, roll to all. Fallback: reimage to older mlx5 driver for one cluster.
Devon: Note: disabling offloads increases host CPU for high-throughput workloads; monitor node CPU and GPU throttling.
Joel: Uploaded pcap: https://internal-artifacts.redwood/pcaps/encap-loss-1769987654.pcap
Maria: Long-term: open vendor case with Mellanox, file kernel regtest, consider changing overlay MTU to avoid boundary and evaluate VXLAN vs Geneve.
Ashley: Added console alert to fire on encap checksum errors and retransmit rate per node.
Devon: Repro job update: loss fell from 1.4% -> 0.02% post-offload-disable. Collecting CPU counters.
Maria: If node shows >2% sustained loss, cordon and evict GPU pods. We'll prepare a postmortem and customer mitigation guide for Dedicated.
Ashley: Canary looks green after 15m. Proceeding to next 30%.
Maria: Thanks all :thumbsup:
